note: Each price is the town guide's own figure, read from the guide's own data file.

towns.name: Little River
towns.wow: About two of every three deeded boat slips in the county are here: slips you buy and own, each on its own deed.
towns.rule: The county asks for a business license and tax filings. An HOA can still say no.

towns.name: North Myrtle Beach
towns.where: Its own city, north of Myrtle Beach
towns.wow: The shag, the state dance, is still danced on Main Street. At Fat Harold's Beach Club, the home of the shag, DJs play every night from 7.
towns.rule: A yearly city business license, and no special zoning or permit beyond it. An HOA or the deed can still bar rentals.

towns.name: Myrtle Beach
towns.group: a resold house in the city
towns.where: The city in the middle of the Grand Strand
towns.wow: Downtown, the Boardwalk is about 1.3 miles long, beside the ocean. The airport is inside the city, with nonstop flights to more than 50 destinations.
towns.rule: Only in the zones the city allows. Most neighborhoods of houses are not zoned for it.

towns.name: Surfside Beach
towns.where: A town south of Myrtle Beach
towns.wow: The town's concrete pier reaches 814 feet into the ocean, and walking on it is free.
towns.rule: Only in the two zones by the ocean.

also.group: a house on the inland streets

towns.name: Garden City
towns.group: a condo on the ocean side by the pier, on the Horry part
towns.where: Between Surfside Beach and Murrells Inlet, in two counties
towns.wow: At the far end of the Garden City Pier, people learn line dances out over the ocean.
towns.rule: Horry side: the county asks for a business license and tax filings. Georgetown end: the county requires no business license.

towns.name: Murrells Inlet
towns.group: a house on the Horry side
towns.where: On the salt marsh, split by the county line
towns.wow: The MarshWalk is a wooden boardwalk along the salt marsh, lined with restaurants, and its live music is free to hear.
towns.rule: Horry side: the county asks for a business license and tax filings. Georgetown side: the county requires no business license.

towns.name: Pawleys Island
towns.window: Georgetown County parcel sale dates, 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 (the island figure: 2023-10-01 to 2026-09-30)
towns.where: The south end, in Georgetown County
towns.wow: The old island houses were built mostly of cypress, hewn on the mainland. Each timber was chiseled with Roman numerals so the house could be put together on the island.

also.group: an island house, over three years of sales

towns.name: Carolina Forest
towns.where: Inland, outside any city or town
towns.wow: The county's Bike and Run Park, on the Intracoastal Waterway, has about 7 miles of mountain-bike and hiking trails on 70 acres.
towns.rule: The county asks for a business license and tax filings. An HOA can still say no.

towns.name: Conway
towns.group: a resold house or townhouse in the city
towns.wow: Riverfront Park on the Waccamaw has a playground built like a steamboat, the F.G. Burroughs, beside a riverwalk of about 1.5 miles.
towns.rule: We check the city's zoning for each address.
